# ui-sdk (vendored)

Unmodified copy of `@ui-sdk/web` 0.1.0-beta.4 (`web.js` and `web/`), from https://ui-sdk.dev, source https://github.com/vercel-labs/ui.
License: Apache-2.0, text in `LICENSE`. Loaded by every page from `vendor/ui-sdk/web.js`, so the site has no runtime dependency on another host.
Keep `web.js` and `web/` side by side: the loader imports components from `./web/`.
